style_goal: Real-world reading tasks presented as visual artefacts such as tickets, schedules, menus, booking cards, noticeboards, and digital messages.

under_12.title: Cinema ticket — Finding your screen
under_12.question: Which screen should you go to?
under_12.visual_hint: A colourful cinema ticket with large time, screen number, and seat.

under_12.title: Zoo map sign — Finding the animals
under_12.question: You want to see the lions. Which way should you go?
under_12.visual_hint: A playful zoo direction sign with icons for each animal area.

under_12.title: Birthday party schedule — Knowing what comes next
under_12.question: What happens at 2:00 PM?
under_12.visual_hint: A bright party timetable with playful icons beside each activity.

12_15.title: Gaming event schedule — Finding your match
12_15.question: Where should you go for Pixel Quest?
12_15.visual_hint: An esports-style event board with game titles, times, and zones.

12_15.title: Food truck menu — Using the deal board
12_15.question: How much is the meal deal?
12_15.visual_hint: A chalkboard-style menu with one deal highlighted in a bright label.

12_15.title: Theme park ride notice — Reading the rules
information: Children must keep seat belts fastened.
12_15.question: What is the minimum height for the ride?
12_15.visual_hint: A ride information board with safety icons and a height marker.

16_18.title: Festival lineup — Finding the right act
16_18.question: Which act starts at 7:30 PM?
16_18.visual_hint: A festival timetable poster with bold act names and stage times.

16_18.title: Work rota — Checking your shift
16_18.question: What time does Jamie start work?
16_18.visual_hint: A staff rota displayed like one pinned in a café or shop.

16_18.title: Parcel collection message — Finding the locker
16_18.question: Which locker should you open?
16_18.visual_hint: A phone notification or text message with a clear locker number and pickup code.

18_plus.title: Boarding pass — Finding your gate
18_plus.question: Which gate should you go to?
18_plus.visual_hint: A realistic boarding pass with flight, gate, seat, and boarding time.

18_plus.title: Train connection board — Changing platforms
18_plus.question: After changing at Reading, which platform should you go to?
18_plus.visual_hint: A split journey card showing the first train and the connection underneath.

18_plus.title: Appointment card — Arriving on time
18_plus.question: What time should you arrive?
18_plus.visual_hint: A clean appointment card or SMS confirmation with time and arrival note highlighted.
